== Original post ==

'''Schele's Bounty Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele
* '''Published:''' October 31, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 5
* '''Description:''' The Quilted Quicker Picker Upper.

=== Strategy ===

This is the exact version of the deck I played on Day 3 of worlds (Pistone played a Sniper & Dark Strike instead of the 2nd Mara, which is probably a good choice). Im not going to pretend like this is the best version of the deck, or that it cant be improved, but this is the best version I came up with after a couple of months of iterations with minimal testing. Props go to Rustan Sharer for some of the concepts in this deck, and Michael Pistone for some of the final card choices in here.

History

After the release of Virtual Set 8, Rustan and I were talking about the ruling on Vaders Bounty (V) that Vader and Fett could never die. So after looking over V8, more specifically All Wrapped Up(V), we came up with the basic concept for the Bounty Deck. Rustan pointed out that Fett CC (V) made Bounty retrieval immune to Aim High, and that Fetts Gun (V) pulled a ton of effects, including Special Delivery (V). So we put the pieces together, starting CCT to get a captive at the start, with Any Methods Necessary for Fett CC (V), Fetts Gun (V), and the JP: Dungeon. The deck ran Bad Feeling Have I (V) that was pulled by Special Delivery (V) to pull DLOTS, and DLOTS and Fett sat at the Carbon Chamber with the captive. The key was the fact that Fett was holding the captive and could not die, and therefore you would never lose your Bounty retrieval. We threw in Kuat Drive Yards (V) and Kashyyyk, along with some stuff to hold the system (I believe it was Maul in ship then too), and some other random cards to try and cause damage/win battles, and the deck was doing extremely well in playtesting (remember this was the height of TRM and other similar decks). Unfortunately, Vaders Bounty (V) was erratad so that Fett and Vader could die soon after the development of the deck, so the deck was shelved before ever seeing the light of day. Instead, we moved on to a decent scum deck that abused Den Of Thieves (V), which worked out quite well for us

Fast forward to the redux, and the change to IG-88 (V). After it was ruled that IG-88 (V)s gametext for canceling weapon destiny did not violate the one rule, Rustan and I realized this could give us our guy that could stay alive to keep our Bounties going. And so this deck was brought back to life.

Strategy

This deck is not simple to play. Every card in this deck has a purpose, and even cutting the deck to these 60 cards was tough. Anyway, the basic strategy is this: Get IG-88 (V) out, get Trevaggs Gun and Thermal Detonator on him, have him take the captive, set up your hand, get him to the carbon chamber, with Fett (V), and sit there while disrupting/causing damage/retrieving a ton. Yes, the deck really is that complicated. It requires intelligent decision making for virtually everything you do, calculated risks, and overall basically knowing what the heck youre doing.

Ill try to break it down the best I can.

Early Game: Use Double Back/drawing cards to get IG-88 (V) out. When you get him, make sure you can put him with his gun on the table, or have Stunning Leader in hand, or youre playing a deck that wont come at you early. Get him on table, put Lando with him, set up your hand and make sure you get out the gun on IG-88 (V). Once youre confident with the interrupt selection in your hand, move IG and Lando to the Carbon Chamber. If theyre coming to battle you, make sure you get Fett (V) and Binders out, so you can start capturing everyone they put down to try and battle you with.

Mid-Game: Start pinging away, disrupting their set up. Set up Tatooine/Maul/Sith Infiltrator(/Gela if they have cannons). If you need to cause damage, you can use Carbon Freezing to cause 8(Prepare the Chamber is pullable with the console and adds 2, Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V) adds 2 and is pullable by both Boba Fett (V) and IG-88 (V) from Force Pile), or Aiii! Aaa! Agggggg! to cause a decent amount against most decks (note: you cannot play Aiii! Aaa! Aggggg! targeting a captive that is Frozen, so you have to decide whether the quick 8 damage is worth it, or if the Aiii! Aaa! Agggggg! damage that you can do multiple times is better for the game youre in, unless of course they give you another captive, then you can do both). Get Thermal Detonator on IG-88 (V), get Fett (V) out at the Carbon Chamber. If youre battling, you have tons of tricks to keep your guys alive. IG-88 (V) cannot be hit by weapons ever, since you can lose a force to cancel any weapon destiny that could hit him. Self Destruct Mechanism allows you to retarget weapons to IG-88(which you can then cancel the weapon destinies for). Defensive Fire (V) will capture someone, then you can Stunning Leader to cancel the battle, then battle them back to capture someone else likely leaving one(or no) characters left at the site. Human Shield lets you forfeit your captives, and All Wrapped Up (V) lets you recapture one of those captives you forfeited (it is subjected to the one rule, unfortunately). Remember you can lose force liberally with IG-88s text, lost interrupts, Mauls cloaking, etc. because you will retrieve it all back.

Late Game: Retrieve a lot with Bounty. On the turn you want to retrieve with Bounty, deploy as many Bounties as you want on the highest forfeit captive (even frozen) IG-88 (V) is escorting (each Bounty is a separate retrieval, so this is legal). During your move phase, play Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V) to allow your Bounty Hunters to move two additional times during your move phase. Move IG-88 (V) over to the prison, put the captive into the prison, retrieve for your Bounties. For each Bounty, the amount you retrieve depends on the captive you get. You take the forfeit of the captive, subtract 2 from Bounty, and add 3 from Thermal Detonator (the whole key to the card in the deck). For example, if they give you Corran Horn, you retrieve 5  2 + 3 = 6 per Bounty. Generally youll retrieve between 5 and 7 per bounty, sometimes youll get lucky and get an EPP or something to retrieve 8-9 per Bounty. And remember, Boba Fett CC (V) makes Bounty retrieval IMMUNE TO AIM HIGH. For each Bounty you retrieve, you can take any one of the cards retrieved into hand. This allows you to cycle interrupts like Stunning Leader/Limited Resources/Aii! Aaa! Aggggg!, and allows you to retrieve anything killed (like your EPPs, Maul/Ship) to then redeploy. From here you just damage them the best you can to finish the game through drains/interrupts, and odds are the retrieval will be too much for them to handle.

Card Choices

<nowiki/>-Prepared Defenses- I feel this is a better start for this deck to make sure AWU is on table at the start, also gives you Special Delivery (V) and SAC protection.

<nowiki/>-All Wrapped Up (V) - The card that makes the deck work.

<nowiki/>-Special Delivery (V) - Takes away stuff like Resilience from the LS, plus allows you to pull effects like No Escape, Security Precautions, and Imperial Decree (V) right away.

<nowiki/>-Oppressive Enforcement & There Is No Try- Forcing the opponent to lose 3 cards in order to send something of yours to used pile only helps your goal to cause damage.

<nowiki/>-Tatooine (Ep1) - Drain +1 if Maul there, so it gives you a solid system to drain for 2 at and establishes Battle Plan/Order so you can ping for free on Cloud City as well.

<nowiki/>-Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) - Pullable with your objective so you can set up Search and Destroy against space decks.

<nowiki/>-IG-88 (V) x2- He can never be hit by weapons, and he digs through your force pile every turn for a card. A no brainer for a deck that starts with a captive.

<nowiki/>-Boba Fett CC (V) x2- He makes Bounty retrieval Immune to Aim High, thats reason enough to include him in the deck. But of course, he pulls cards with Bounty in the title, which primarily is Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V).

<nowiki/>-Darth Maul x2- This was originally EPP Maul, but it was switched for the ability to drain over people. Most ability 4 pilots that youll see put in front of Maul will be Luke or Corran, and then you drop MAIH.

<nowiki/>-Darth Vader With Lightsaber- Character to disrupt with, or go to the docking bay to set up Search and Destroy.

<nowiki/>-Mara Jade, The Emperors Hand (V) x2- Two of her because she doesnt have to worry about lightsaber combat or any other stuff Dark Jedi do, plus shes a spy to attack the opponent at nonbattlegrounds.

<nowiki/>-Lando Calrissian (V) - Pullable at the start of the game, deploys for cheap, and helps you capture guys(and carbon freeze!).

<nowiki/>-4-LOM With Concussion Rifle- Primarily for the QMC matchup or something thats going to come at the Prison before youre ready, so you can take the captive and run until youre ready to get down IG and support. Probably not necessary, but I like having it in there for a just-in-case sort of deal.

<nowiki/>-Gela Yeens (V) - Prevents Mauls ship from being shot down unless they have Choke, and if they do have Choke, then you just retrieve him again with Bounty and deploy him again.

<nowiki/>-Mauls Sith Infiltrator x2- Cloaking( + MAIH) + Immune to attrition + Destiny 6. Not much more needs to be said than that.

<nowiki/>-Feltipern Trevaggs Stun Rifle (V) - Fires for free at +2 to capture, and when you do capture you can take one of your many interrupts in your lost pile into hand. Definitely the best capturing gun in the game.

<nowiki/>-Boba Fetts Blaster Rifle (V) - Opponent cannot Dodge away, Force drain +1 when you have a captive at same site, and again is +2 to capture.

<nowiki/>-Thermal Detonator- Adds 3 to each Bounty retrieved. This card is kind of good in this deck

<nowiki/>-Bounty x6- Self explanatory. I didnt bother with the other goofy bounties because theyre situational.

<nowiki/>-Carbon Freezing- Causes 8 force loss. If they do not deploy to the Carbon Chamber, you can freeze with a destiny draw of 1 (+2 from the site, +3 from the Console, +2 from Prepare the Chamber, +2 from Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V), +1 from Lando (V)).

<nowiki/>-Security Precautions- Activation +1, causes damage against HB, gives you immunity to battle damage. I expected more HB at worlds than actually showed up, so thats why it was included.

<nowiki/>-Imperial Decree (V) - Allows you to generally ignore WHAP and Profit direct damage, and will give you activation against decks that put a ton of icons on table.

<nowiki/>-Much Anger In Him- If theyre dumb enough to put an ability 4 Rebel up in space, you win the game.

<nowiki/>-Search And Destroy- Again, I expected more space decks than I actually saw. Set this up with the CC:DB.

<nowiki/>-No Escape- Prevents Honor from reducing the force loss from Carbon Freezing and Much Anger In Him.

<nowiki/>-Human Shield x2- This card allows you to not lose actual characters to attrition(assuming battles get that far). Play this, forfeit a bunch of captives, and currently(until ruled otherwise, which it likely will be), you can recapture one of the captives you forfeited with All Wrapped Up (V).

<nowiki/>-Double Back x3- Used interrupt (with AWU (V)) that pulls bounty hunters for you, and late game basically becomes a pay 1 force to retrieve 1 force Used Interrupt(assuming you can track the bounty hunters around to keep losing).

<nowiki/>-Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V) x2- This card has 3 awesome functions. (1) Adds 2 to an attempt to carbon freeze. (2) Adds 2 to the weapon destiny for a weapon fired by a bounty hunter. (3) (Best text) Allows your bounty hunters to make 2 additional moves in your move phase. This allows you to deploy your bounties, move over, collect, and then move back to the carbon chamber all in the same turn.

<nowiki/>-Prepare The Chamber- Pullable with the console to add 2 to the carbon freezing. Probably not that necessary, but I included it anyway to guarantee an early freeze.

<nowiki/>-Aiiii! Aaa! Aggggggggggg! - This card can cause a fairly significant amount of damage, and you can keep retrieving it to play again with the Bounties. The damage can add up fast if you get it working

<nowiki/>-Masterful Move & Endor Occupation- Keeps Savrip and Celebration off the table.

<nowiki/>-Jabbas Through With You x2- Pulls weapons for you(including the detonator), and adds a battle destiny when you fire a bounty hunter weapon.

<nowiki/>-Defensive Fire (V) x2- Even the threat of this card prevents the LS from initiating battle against your characters, its that good. You can play this, capture someone, then follow it with Stunning Leader if you desire.

<nowiki/>-Levitation Attack (V) - Gets the Binders out. Im not sure if this is better than just playing Binders main deck though.

<nowiki/>-Self Destruct Mechanism x2- A Used destiny 4 interrupt that retargets weapons to IG-88 for you to then cancel the weapon destinies. Definitely good.

<nowiki/>-Stunning Leader x2- Cancels battles, and once again, works well in conjunction with Defensive Fire (V)

<nowiki/>-Limited Resources- Just a great card, and you can end up playing it multiple times

Weaknesses

Obviously cards like Sense, Clash of Sabers(to prevent you from moving), and other cancellers are the bane of this deck. A deck that doesnt give you a Rebel is pretty much an autoloss, but youll be hard pressed to find many of those outside of WHAP(which may play Mothma), Hyperdrive (which is likely Obi start, and may play Rebel Obi (V) for you to start out with captured, in which case you autowin), and QMC Aliens (which you should be able to start capturing their aliens to start retrieving with). I know for a fact that this deck isnt perfect, but it definitely has a ton of potential and is no slouch even in its current form.

Where to go from here?

There were a million 61st cards to put into this deck. Imperial Artillery, Sniper & Dark Strike, Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch, etc, but its tough to fit everything you want in here while keeping the core (the Bounty engine) intact. I pointed out in the card choices section which cards can probably be switched out for some of those listed.

The main thing the deck needs is another way to cause damage. Youd think between the Carbon Freezing, ping drains, Limited Resources, Aiii! Aaa! Aggggg!, Much Anger In Him, and battling that youd be causing enough damage to finish the game, but a lot of times you cannot. Im completely open to suggestions here, but Ive exhausted a lot of options. As long as you keep the core of the deck together (Bounty, AWU(V), IG/Fett, interrupts to protect them), you can take out the other cards (EPPs, space package, other meta cards), and try find a better way to cause damage to win the game. You can attempt to switch to Any Methods Necessary start, but then you have to play the inferior IGs gun(instead of Trevaggs), and you have to dig out AWU(V). Here is what I would consider the core cards (to build from):

Fear Is My Ally OR Drop(V)

Carbon Chamber Testing/You Dont Want To See This Side

Carbonite Chamber Console

Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber

Cloud City: Security Tower

Prepared Defense or Any Methods Necessary

IG-88 (V) x2 (2nd one not needed if you go with AMN)

Boba Fett CC (V) x2

Lando Calrissian (V)

Feltipern Trevaggs Stun Rifle (V) (or IGs if you go with AMN)

Boba Fetts Blaster Rifle (V)

Thermal Detonator

Bounty x6

All Wrapped Up (V)

Human Shield x2

Double Back x3 (unless you play AMN)

Hes All Yours Bounty Hunter (V) x2

Jabbas Through With You x2

Defensive Fire (V) x2

Self Destruct Mechanism x2

Thats 34 cards (less if you go with AMN start). The last 26 cards have to provide activation and damage. Like I said, Im sure better options are out there, and my list came after only a couple of months of consideration and very little playtesting.

If you have any ideas or questions regarding this deck, feel free to contact me either through email (BSchele@gmail.com) or AIM (dasfi).

Brandon Schele

2004 SWCCG World Champion
